AEP009_affine_set_step.conclusion: ratio 36 exceeds the cube-doubling factor 4; arbitrary-set affine control used on p. 5 is not implied by doubling. This does not disprove the finite-union lemma or its Lebesgue specialization.

AEP016_vector_log_range.conclusion: The printed range includes K<1, where the vector-log RHS is negative; operational restriction K>1 is necessary.

AEP016_Lemma2_7_supplement.analytic_argument_to_record: gamma(t)~t^(2-p)/(p(p-1)) as t->infinity by l'Hopital on its defining tail integral, hence gamma(t)->infinity and the Taylor lower bound G(t)>=p(p-1)/2*(t+gamma(t))^(p-2)*gamma(t)^2 tends to infinity. Boundary G(0)=gamma(0)^p>=gamma(0)/2 follows from gamma(0)^(p-1)=Gamma(p/(p-1))^(p-1)/p>=1/p>1/2. At an interior minimum G'=0 gives (t+gamma)^(p-1)-t^(p-1)=1/p; the ODE gives G=(gamma-t*gamma')/p>=gamma(0)/p>gamma(0)/2 because gamma is concave. This independently supplies the missing global-minimum argument; other source steps remain as printed.
AEP016_Lemma2_7_supplement.conclusion: Exact algebra checked; asymptotic/minimum argument is recorded as a W25 analytic supplement pending independent review.
